 Follow Andrew Shue marries Marilee Fiebig, weeks after their exes Amy Robach and T.J. Holmes tied the knot
 The couple’s “low-key” ceremony was held at their 92-acre New Jersey estate on Sunday.
 Ryan Coleman Mon, November 2, 2026 at 3:02 AM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Marilee Fiebig and Andrew Shue in New York City in 2024
Credit: Cindy Ord/Getty Key Points
 Andrew Shue and Marilee Fiebig have tied the knot after three years of dating.
 The Melrose Place star and immigration attorney wed in a "low-key" ceremony at their 92-acre New Jersey estate on Sunday.
 Shue and Fiebig bonded after their respective former spouses, Good Morning America anchors Amy Robach and T.J. Holmes, went public with their relationship in 2022.
 Andrew Shue and Marilee Fiebig are officially married!
 The Melrose Place alum and the immigration attorney tied the knot on Sunday in a "low-key" ceremony at their 92-acre estate outside of Stockton, N.J., confirms Entertainment Weekly 's sister site PEOPLE . The Daily Mail also published photos of Fiebig in her white lace wedding gown.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The nuptials come just days after news broke that Shue and Fiebig were engaged . The couple famously bonded after their former spouses, Good Morning America anchors Amy Robach and T.J. Holmes, were romantically linked .
 Robach and Holmes, meanwhile, got married last month in Arkansas.
 Andrew Shue in 2023 and Marilee Fiebig in 2024 
 Credit: Jason Mendez/Getty; Marilee Fiebig/Instagram 
 "We're very grateful and hopeful," Shue told PEOPLE last week about his engagement to Fiebig. "I don't know how it happened, but there's a happy ending."
 The photographs of the wedding show Sabine, Fiebig's 13-year-old daughter with Holmes, serving as one of her bridesmaids alongside the attorney's close friend, finance executive Lisa Bashishow. The groom's sister, Oscar-nominated Leaving Las Vegas actress Elisabeth Shue, also attended the ceremony.
 Advertisement Advertisement Entertainment Weekly has reached out to representatives for Shue and Fiebig for comment.
 Shue and Fiebig, coincidentally, were both married to their previous spouses from 2010 to 2023. Fiebig and Holmes share Sabine, while Shue did not have any children with Robach.
 "Relationships are hard. They're messy. They're not perfect. We have fought for love, and I can say I have never been happier. I am with my best friend," Robach said in December 2023, a year after her relationship with Holmes came to light, resulting in the couple's exit from GMA .
 Get your daily dose of entertainment news, celebrity updates, and what to watch with our EW Dispatch newsletter . 
 "Marilee's sole focus has remained on the overall best interest of her 9-year-old daughter," an attorney for Fiebig said at the time .
 Advertisement Advertisement For his part, Shue reflected on how the end of his marriage to Robach led to him finding "The One."
 "I had to accept my own part in marriage not working out for me and in not understanding myself well enough and not understanding what matters in a relationship well enough to find the right person for me, and that has been an extraordinary gift," he told PEOPLE . "I don't know how it happened, but I can say I'm grateful."
